correctness.rationale: Verified companion matrix M has characteristic polynomial x^3-x-1 and exact return M^13=I+3A with A matrix [[2,3,4],[4,5,7],[3,4,5]]. Direct matrix products give unit 3-adic trace slopes at r=1,3,9: 17,29,158. For h with valuation s, nonlinear binomial terms of (I+3A)^h have 3-adic order >=s+2, hence each F_r(m)=R(13m+r)/3 has exact isometric differences and a unique 3-adic zero βr. Regular mod13 branches and r=0 yield the valuation law. Count three root-class residue progressions for pt>=2 and the nine unit classes/other branches, giving p0=9/13,p1=3/13,pt=6/(13*3^t) and discrepancy <=9 from at most nine arithmetic progressions. Independently checked matrix, slopes and 30000 finite indices, and examined VERIFY.py root-lifting/congruence code; finite tests not proof of unbounded statement.
